config.mercantile.title: Mercantile Configuration
config.mercantile.enableVillagerPickup.t: Allow picking up villagers with sneak + right-click
config.mercantile.pickupXpCost.tooltip: XP levels required to pick up a villager
config.mercantile.enableNames.tooltip: Assign random names to villagers on spawn
config.mercantile.enableTradeCycling.too: Allow re-rolling villager trades for emeralds
config.mercantile.enableWanderingTraderR: Allow wandering traders to offer rare bonus trades at high reputation
config.mercantile.reputationTradeGain.to: Reputation gained per N completed trades (N controlled by Trades Per Gain)
config.mercantile.reputationCureGain.too: Reputation gained for curing a zombie villager
config.mercantile.reputationKillLoss.too: Reputation lost for killing a villager
config.mercantile.reputationDailyCap.too: Maximum total reputation a player can earn from villager activity per Minecraft day
config.mercantile.reputationTradesPerGai: Number of completed trades required to earn one Trade Rep Gain
config.mercantile.reputationDailyMaxTrad: Threshold at or above which no further reputation is awarded from trading that day (sub-cap within Daily Rep Cap). With a gain > 1, the awarded total may overshoot this threshold by up to one gain.
config.mercantile.reputationDailyMaxCycl: Threshold at or above which no further reputation is awarded from trade cycling that day (sub-cap within Daily Rep Cap). With a gain > 1, the awarded total may overshoot this threshold by up to one gain.
config.mercantile.enableRaidReputation.t: Award reputation for defending a village from a raid
Reputation granted for winning a raid (bypasses the daily cap, like the cure bonus)
config.mercantile.enableGifting.tooltip: Allow villagers to accept profession-matched item gifts for reputation
config.mercantile.reputationGiftGain.too: Reputation gained per accepted gift item
config.mercantile.reputationDailyMaxGift: Threshold at or above which no further reputation is awarded from gifting that day (sub-cap within Daily Rep Cap)
config.mercantile.reputationNegativeDeca: Points a negative reputation recovers toward 0 each in-game day (0 disables decay; positive scores are never affected)
config.mercantile.enableGratitudeGifts.t: Villagers occasionally toss a small profession-flavored gift to Honored players who spend time near them
config.mercantile.gratitudeGiftsPerDay.t: Maximum gratitude gifts a player can receive per in-game day (0 disables)
config.mercantile.enableNitwitRehab.tool: Trusted+ players can convert an adult nitwit to an unemployed villager by using a golden apple on it and paying an emerald fee
config.mercantile.nitwitRehabEmeraldCost: Emeralds drawn from the player's inventory when rehabilitating a nitwit, on top of the golden apple (0 makes the apple the only cost)
config.mercantile.enableFollowMode.toolt: Allow villagers to follow the player
Maximum villagers that can follow a player at once
config.mercantile.enableSendHome.tooltip: When dismissed, villagers walk back to their bed or workstation instead of stopping in place
config.mercantile.enablePathfindingFixes: Master toggle for all pathfinding improvements
config.mercantile.enablePathfindingDoors: Villagers properly path through open fence gates and double doors
config.mercantile.enablePathfindingStair: Villagers traverse multi-step staircases and slab transitions
config.mercantile.enablePathfindingLadde: Villagers can climb ladders when pathfinding
config.mercantile.enablePathfindingWater: Villagers path around water instead of walking into it
config.mercantile.enableBulkTrading.tool: Shift-click to execute a trade multiple times
config.mercantile.enableWorkOrders.toolt: Sneak + right-click an unemployed villager with a workstation item to send it to claim the nearest unclaimed workstation of that type
config.mercantile.workOrderEmeraldCost.t: Emeralds drawn from the player's inventory per accepted work order (0 makes orders free; creative always waived)
config.mercantile.enableContracts.toolti: Employed villagers occasionally ask for deliveries: sneak + use paper to sign the offer, hand over the goods before the deadline, and earn emeralds plus cap-bypassing reputation (requires reputation)
config.mercantile.contractOfferChance.to: Percent chance per villager per in-game day of a new contract offer appearing (0 stops new offers)
config.mercantile.contractPaymentScale.t: Emerald payments as a percent of the data-driven pool values (100 = as authored)
config.mercantile.contractRepGain.toolti: Reputation per completed delivery; bypasses the daily cap like curing and raid defense
config.mercantile.contractRepPerDay.tool: Deliveries per day that earn the reputation bonus; later deliveries still pay emeralds (0 disables contract rep)
config.mercantile.contractDeadlineDays.t: In-game days between signing a contract and its delivery deadline; expired contracts vanish without penalty
config.mercantile.enableHealing.tooltip: Apply healing/regen multiplier to villagers hit by splash or lingering potions
config.mercantile.healingMultiplier.tool: Potion healing multiplier for villagers (1.0 = vanilla)
config.mercantile.enableRestockIndicator: Show restock timer in the trade GUI
config.mercantile.enableDemandTransparen: Show price breakdown tooltip in the trade GUI
config.mercantile.enableTradePinning.too: Pin trades in the trade GUI and get an action-bar notice when they restock nearby
config.mercantile.maxPinnedTradesPerPlay: Cap on pinned trades each player may hold (1-64)
Max distance in blocks between player and villager for a restock notification (8-256)
config.mercantile.enableSentryPylon.tool: Enable the sentry pylon block and crafting recipe
config.mercantile.enablePylonBellAlarm.t: On detecting a threat, the pylon rings the nearest village bell within its radius
config.mercantile.pylonDetectionRadius.t: Sentry pylon hostile mob scan radius in blocks
config.mercantile.pylonMaxFuel.tooltip: Maximum iron blocks a pylon can store
config.mercantile.pylonMaxGolems.tooltip: Maximum active sentry golems per pylon
config.mercantile.sentryDespawnSeconds.t: Seconds before idle sentry golems despawn
config.mercantile.pylonTribulationGolemB: Extra sentry golems allowed per Tribulation threat tier (only active when Tribulation is installed)
config.mercantile.pylonTribulationRadius: Extra detection radius in blocks per Tribulation threat tier (only active when Tribulation is installed)
config.mercantile.pylonTribulationMaxGol: Hard cap on sentry golems per pylon under Tribulation scaling (only active when Tribulation is installed)
config.mercantile.villagerSoundVolume.to: Volume for villager sounds (0.0 = muted, 1.0 = full)
config.mercantile.enableWorkstationVis.t: Show particle lines between villagers and their workstations
config.mercantile.enableBellRadiusVis.to: Show bell gathering radius when holding a bell
config.mercantile.enableInfoPanel.toolti: Show extended villager info panel in the trade GUI
config.mercantile.enableReputationHud.to: Show a compact reputation indicator on the HUD when villagers are nearby
config.mercantile.enableTierChangeMessag: Show a chat notice when your reputation tier changes
config.mercantile.hudAnchor.tooltip: Screen corner the reputation HUD is anchored to
config.mercantile.hudOffsetX.tooltip: Horizontal distance in pixels from the anchored screen edge
config.mercantile.hudOffsetY.tooltip: Vertical distance in pixels from the anchored screen edge

tooltip.mercantile.breeding.label: Breeding: %s
Show villager breeding status, cooldown, food, and baby age in Jade/WTHIT tooltips
config.mercantile.enableBabyFeeding.tool: Right-click a baby villager with villager food to speed up its growth
config.mercantile.babyFeedPercentPerFeed: Percent of remaining growth time removed per bread fed (lower-value foods scale down)
config.mercantile.babyFeedMaxReductionPe: Cap on total growth time a single baby can have removed by feeding, as a percent of the full growth time
mercantile.feeding.capped: This baby villager cannot be fed any further
tooltip.mercantile.mood.label: Mood: %s
config.mercantile.enableMood.tooltip: Villagers track a mood from living conditions (bed, workstation, sleep, food, safety) that gently nudges prices and restock speed
config.mercantile.moodPriceModifierPerce: Price nudge as a percent of base price: Happy villagers discount by this much, Miserable ones mark up (0 disables)
config.mercantile.moodRestockSpeedPercen: Restock interval change: Happy villagers restock this percent sooner, Miserable ones later (0 disables)
config.mercantile.moodRecalcIntervalTick: Ticks between mood re-evaluations; mood drifts a couple of points toward current conditions per interval
config.mercantile.moodAmbientParticles.t: Happy villagers occasionally emit happy particles; Miserable ones emit angry particles
message.mercantile.market_day: Market day! Trades are discounted and villagers restock more.
message.mercantile.pin_cap: Pin limit reached (%s) — unpin a trade first
config.mercantile.enableMemorials.toolti: A named villager's death drops a memorial keepsake recording their name, profession, level, and cause of death
config.mercantile.enableMourning.tooltip: Villagers near a villager death briefly stop, face the spot, and shed grief tears (cosmetic only)
config.mercantile.enableFearMarkup.toolt: Killing several villagers in one village quickly makes that village's survivors mark up prices for the killer, decaying over a few in-game days
config.mercantile.fearKillThreshold.tool: Villager kills in the same village within the kill window needed to trigger the fear markup
Minutes (real time) in which the threshold kills must land to count as a spree
config.mercantile.fearMarkupPercent.tool: Price markup when fear is fresh, as a percent of base price; it decays linearly to zero over the duration (0 disables the price effect)
config.mercantile.fearMarkupDurationDays: In-game days for a village's fear of the killer to fade completely
config.mercantile.enableMarketDay.toolti: Every few days villages hold a dawn-to-dusk market day with discounted trades and an extra restock cycle
In-game days between market days; the schedule is shared by the whole world
config.mercantile.marketDayDiscountPerce: Discount on every trade during market day, as a percent of base price; stacks with reputation and gossip (0 disables the discount)
